variants.name: Succeeded
variants.summary: A run that went live: every step checked, the last one open, a Completed Tag with Deployed in 42s and the view switch in the Logs row, and copy on every step log.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: A run whose routing rules were rejected: that step is open on its error output with a Failed Tag and the reason in full, the steps behind it read Skipped, and the Logs row names the failed step beside the view switch.

variants.name: CompleteView
variants.summary: The Complete view of a finished run: every line the pipeline printed as one continuous LogView with its copy button.

variants.name: FailedCompleteView
variants.summary: The Complete view of the failed run: the lines up to the error, as one LogView, nothing from the steps that never ran.
